_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::fbi#4. The rule holds — beam visualisation needs IO/RUNTIME VTK OUTPUT/BEAMS — but the entry said the STRUCTURE subsection 'produces empty output'. It produces NO FILE: replacing the BEAMS block of upstream fbi_mortar_solidcoupling.4C.yaml with IO/RUNTIME VTK OUTPUT/STRUCTURE (OUTPUT_STRUCTURE + DISPLACEMENT) drops the structure-beams .vtu files to zero and the .pvd collections from 3 to 2, with no replacement structure-*.vtu of any kind. The run still exits 0, passes all six result tests, and keeps writing the beam-to-fluid coupling .vtu files, which is precisely what makes it look like output worked. No diagnostic is printed. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C (2026.2.0-dev, commit 89519cfe76).

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: give the second arm the correct BEAMS subsection. It then writes the same beam files as the first, STRUCTURE_ARM_BEAM_VTU becomes 2 (a forbidden token) and STRUCTURE_ARM_PVD becomes 3, so the fixture must go red.
_mutation.from:
WRONG_OUTPUT_SECTION='IO/RUNTIME VTK OUTPUT/STRUCTURE:
  OUTPUT_STRUCTURE: true
  DISPLACEMENT: true
'
